name: Honda XL750 Transalp
engine: 755 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, ride-by-wire
intro: Honda's modern middleweight adventure bike. Some 2024-2025 bikes have an oil leak recall for a crankcase sealing bolt.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2024-2025 Transalps are in recall 25V358 for a crankcase sealing bolt that can leak oil onto the rear tire.
A-002.reason: Oil on the tire can cause a crash. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Crankcase sealing bolt may be faulty and leak oil onto the rear tire.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the sealing bolt free.
